lesson_title: Cost and Revenue: Finding the Profit Peak
hook_text: This firm makes profit at 6 units. And producing 6 is still the WRONG answer.
clip_script: Walk the table. Unit one: brings R30, costs R18 — produce it, R12 ahead. Unit two: R30 versus R12 — produce, R18 ahead. Unit three: R30 versus R10 — produce. Unit four: R30 versus R16 — produce. Unit five: R30 versus R26 — still R4 ahead — produce. Unit six: R30 versus R38 — this unit destroys R8 of profit. Refuse it. Stop at five. The rule — produce until marginal revenue equals marginal cost — found the answer without computing a single profit figure.
visual_style: Units marching across the screen one by one, each stamped green 'PRODUCE' or red 'REFUSE' as its marginal numbers flash up.
pacing: Rhythmic unit-by-unit beat accelerating to the red-stamp refusal on unit six.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and build the whole six-column table.
